name: Poison Effect
description: p.107. Roll the die of the poison level to determine the poison effect: Minor (level 1) roll D3, Major (level 2) roll 1D, Severe (level 3) roll D3+3. Each effect lasts until a successful END check, made at the start of each interval.

results.text: Illness: -2 DM for feeling fatigued and nauseous
Tranquilizing: Knocked out until a successful END check
Confusion: Must make a successful INT of 8+ to attempt to perform any Skill. Failure means the spacer forgets what it is and cannot attempt to perform the Skill.
Paralysis: Cannot move until a successful END check.
Neurological: D3 + poison level of INT damage.
Necrotic: 1D damage to either DEX or STR.
